title: `plasma-apply-colorscheme -a` should also enable accent color if color scheme was not already using it
line: plasma-apply-colorscheme -a now switches Plasma to that custom accent color, instead of only tinting the palette while the settings stay on "from wallpaper" or "from color scheme".
explanation: With -a, plasma-apply-colorscheme only re-applied the color scheme with the accent tint and never stored the accent itself, so AccentColor stayed unset and accentColorFromWallpaper stayed on. The Colors page kept showing "Accent color from wallpaper" or "from color scheme", the next wallpaper change replaced the color, and switching color scheme dropped it. The tool now saves the color as the custom accent (also as the last used custom one) and turns off the wallpaper mode, like choosing a custom accent in the Colors page.

commits.message:
plasma-apply-colorscheme: switch to a custom accent color with -a

Passing an accent color only tinted the palette and left the accent mode
alone, so it showed as "from wallpaper" or "from color scheme" and got
replaced on the next wallpaper or scheme change. Now it saves the color.

BUG: 472792

media.caption: Before: after `plasma-apply-colorscheme -a red` the palette is red but the Colors page still says "Accent color from wallpaper" and no swatch is selected
After: the same command switches to "Custom accent color" with red selected

review.text: Cleanly persists `AccentColor`, `LastUsedCustomAccentColor`, and `accentColorFromWallpaper = false` via `ColorsSettings` when `-a` is passed to `plasma-apply-colorscheme`, following the same `applyScheme` + `settings->save()` + `notifyKcmChange` pattern used by the scheme-switching branch. This ensures the Colors KCM reflects the custom accent color and prevents subsequent wallpaper or color scheme changes from overwriting it. Before/after screenshots and regression checks confirm the fix.
